blocks.text: VATICAN CITY, Holy See—Pope Leo XIV warned Friday against giving artificial intelligence agents legal personhood or rights. He said the responsibility for their actions should lie firmly with their human creators. “Machines are tools, not persons,” he said in a speech to leading international AI experts gathered at the Vatican for a dialogue on the technology’s future. The forum also tackled the responsibilities of the scientific community and public institutions. “So-called artificial intelligences do not undergo experiences, do not possess a body, do not feel joy or pain, do not mature through relationships and do not know from within what love, work, […]...
